simple.meaning: properly, to hiss , i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate

definitions.full: H5172. nachash II. [ נָחַשׁ verb only Pi`el practise divination, divine, observe signs (denominative from נָהָשׁ according to Nö Zeitschr. f. Völkerpsychol. i (1860), 413 Bau Semitic Rel. i. 287 Lag BN 188 Gerber Verb. Denom. 29 ; otherwise We Skizzen iii. 147 Mei Chrest. Targ. 8. see Ba ES 48 (against him see Sta ThLz April 28, 1894, 235 ); chief difficulty is that Aramaic, which has נַחֵשׁ , has no נָחָשׁ compare RS JPh.xiv. 115 ; — Late Hebrew Qal Participle נוֺחֵשׁ , and Pi`el; Aramaic Pa`el נַחֵשׁ , , all = divine, learn by omens ; perhaps compare also Arabic be unlucky Lane 2775 compare Mei 1.c ); — Perfect 3masculine singular וְנִחֵשׁ 2Kin 21:6 ; 2Chr 33:6 ; 1 singular נִחַ֫שְׁתִּי Gen 30:27 ; Imperfect יְגַחֵשׁ 44:5 , 15 ; 3 masculine plural יְנַחֲשׁוּ 1Kin 20:33 , וַיְנַחָ֑שׁוּ 2Kin 17:17 ; 2 masculine plural תְּנַחֲשׁוּ Lev 19:26 ; Infinitive absolute נַחֵשׁ 1Kin 20:33 ; Participle מְנַחֵשׁ Deut 18:10 (compare especially RS JPhoenician xiv. .113 ff. ); — 1 practise divination Gen 44:5 (J; by means of cup, i.e. by hydromancy), with implied power to learn secret things 44:15 ; condemned by prophetic writer 2Kin 21:6 2Chr 33:6 (+ וְיִדְּעֹנִים אוֺב וְעָשָׂח עוֺנֵן ), 2Kin 17:17 (|| קְסָמִים וַיִּקְסְמוּ ); forbidden in D and H: Deut 18:10 ( + וּמְכַשֵּׁף מְעוֺנֵן קְסָמִים קֹסֵם ), Lev 19:26 (H; || תְּעוֺנֵנ֑וּ ). 2 observe the signs or omens Gen 30:27 (j); so probably יְנַחֲשׁוּ 1Kin 20:33 now the men were observing the signs .
